turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Reddy from Delhi?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am Ananya from Global Connect. I am calling to offer you a special upgrade on your home broadband plan.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Broadband? I already have a connection. Why are you calling?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, we have a high-speed fiber plan that provides unlimited data for only nine thousand five hundred rupees for the entire year.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: That sounds like a lot of money to pay at once. I am not sure.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I understand your concern. It is actually a discounted annual package to save you from monthly billing hassles.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I don't know if I need more speed. My grandson handles these things.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No problem at all, Mr. Reddy. Would you like me to send the plan details to your email or via WhatsApp?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, please send it on WhatsApp. I will ask him to look at it.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Certainly. I will send the brochure over right away.
